name: dither-canvas

changelog.summary: Added a reduced-motion notice: this effect is a continuous cursor-driven fluid distortion and can't be reduced without losing it entirely, so it now surfaces that instead of silently ignoring the preference.

title: Dither Canvas
description: Interactive ASCII-style dither canvas with fluid mouse distortion over video

props.name: videoSrc
props.description: Video source URL used by the effect.

props.name: charColumns
props.description: Controls the density of generated character columns.

props.name: colorizeFromVideo
props.description: Uses video color data instead of fixed monochrome characters.

props.name: videoZoom
props.description: Zoom level applied to the video source.

props.name: charZoom
props.description: Scale factor for the rendered character grid.

props.name: spellBrightChars
props.description: Uses bright sampled areas to spell the configured character phrase.

props.name: disableMobileCursor
props.description: Disables cursor interaction on mobile layouts.

props.name: cursorHint
props.default: Move your cursor to see the binary fluid distortion effect.

props.name: showMobileMessage
props.description: Shows or hides the mobile message overlay.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names for the root canvas element.
